description: The line plot illustrates the micro F1 percentage of KnowPrompt as a function of the number of training samples generated by language models. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated, with values of 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis indicates the micro F1 percentage, ranging from 25% to 52%. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different method: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval. The TACRED line starts at 23% for 8 samples and ends at 30% for 64 samples, showing a gradual increase. The TACRED-Revisit line begins at 24% and ends at 31%, also with a steady rise. The Re-TACRED line starts at 35% and peaks at 51% for 32 samples before slightly decreasing to 48% for 64 samples. The SemEval line begins at 42% and increases to 52% for 64 samples, indicating a consistent improvement. The plot does not include any annotations of data values.
